theme: A wide-open day with one table booked tonight.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar is clear until dinner out this evening — a rare open stretch, and a good one to spend on the two travel decisions that just slipped past their deadlines.

needsAttention.title: December trip is past its decide-by
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due Sept 30 and booking closes Oct 15, the thinnest holiday inventory of the year for six people over three weeks. Pick the lane — domestic, or refundable-only international — and name three destinations.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early and prices up. Book a refundable one now and fix the exact dates later; holding it early costs nothing.

flagged.title: LinkedIn connection requests stacking up
flagged.detail: A run of new requests from governance, ESG and external-affairs people — worth a pass next time you're on LinkedIn, given the board and role search.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions — JetBlue, a Paris stroll, Tombolo Books, a Substack welcome, and a Todoist digest.

recipe.title: Mushroom Ragoût
recipe.why: Peak wild-mushroom season in the northeast — an earthy, unhurried braise that rewards a cool October evening at the stove.

acts.line: A clear morning — nothing on the books until tonight, so the hours are entirely yours.
The afternoon stays open, a real window for the decisions that have been waiting on you.
The day closes out with a table at Pia's at a quarter to eight.
